page.content:
Earth-shaker and lord of the sea.

How Poseidon connects

  • Character: Odysseus — Poseidon delays Odysseus' return after the Cyclops is blinded.
  • Character: Zeus — Zeus and Poseidon divided sky and sea after the Titans fell.

What is Poseidon?

Poseidon received the sea when the brothers drew lots. He raises storms and earthquakes, fathers monsters and horses, and hounds Odysseus after the blinding of Polyphemus.

Key threads lead to Odysseus and Zeus.
